## Summary

Describe the observable behavior or infrastructure outcome.

## Classification

- [ ] MVP

## Validation

- [ ] Tests were written first and observed failing for the expected reason.
- [ ] `make check` passes.
- [ ] No credentials, personal emails, Jira account IDs, or secrets were added.
- [ ] Environment and correlation boundaries are preserved.
- [ ] Documentation and traceability were updated when required.

## Deployment impact

State whether this changes dev, prod, migrations, scoring configuration, Jira
scope, or external mutation behavior. Use `none` when not applicable.
